Therefore, we draw a **dashed line.**

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/75f17da6637e696cd97d49d844818bb0810bbf7abc4a0507ac72dbe4b0a3ceb0.png)

Then, we must decide whether to shade above or below the line. The inequality ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/c3ff3eee7734c983d2915acb172cf1ae2173611edf5e11bf2228a0d2bc1b687d.svg) refers to the ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/1d9b846cface9f9348e4081a0dd87dd254bf26663c12aa0d1a15aa24d2393261.svg)-values that are *less than* those on the line ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/9181ac4b69f87417e52f691a281329f2198fac06b1e05e7fa9f764d2a3448d09.svg) so we shade *below* the line. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/028835cf1d5ad49c29f69bfd7cdf7a716d8fa1b613a7990f9ee4e0f034337ee0.png)

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/e5d1d1c281f864ba901fcae5a980920e155cc19b48a5d73f80546d519837aec2.png)

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14274623/assets/2fa1aaea0475b048dda780feed23f5e9157972f6a5eeed5567f06aa1a5968d88.svg) 

This indicates that we have shaded the correct region.
